question: The sum of the first 19 prime numbers is:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Memorizing the sum of primes in chunks helps save calculation time in exams. Sum of the first 10 prime numbers (2 to 29) = 129 The next 9 primes are: 31, 37, 41, 43, 47, 53, 59, 61, 67. Grouping pairs summing to 100 or close to 100: (31 + 67) + (37 + 61) + (41 + 59) + (47 + 53) + 43 Sum = 129 + 98 + 98 + 100 + 100 + 43 = 568 **∴ The correct answer is 568.**
